desc: 男士草本控油洁面长图，方砖水花首屏、圆标机制与斜切色块收口
name: 男士草本控油洁面乳款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，白底立管干净合规，先建立产品轮廓与管装比例
一秒给出核心主张，用方砖台面与水花把清爽洁净感讲成视觉证据
shots.textZone: upper-left third of the page above the crossed units: one headline line plus one short uppercase eyebrow line

shots.intent: 把买家吐槽的洁面困扰一次列全，让人对号入座后再往下看方案
shots.textZone: top pill banner headline slot plus one two-line label position beneath each of the six ring badges

shots.intent: 按肤质分型放大问题，让油皮与干皮买家各自认领需求
shots.textZone: top moss pill banner plus one label bar along the lower edge of each of the four cards

shots.intent: 用图文交替长条解释草本来源与作用路径，把卖点讲成机制
shots.textZone: top deep olive pill banner plus one text column beside each alternating botanical macro card

shots.intent: 核心利益集中到立管四周，用引导圆标把功效拆成可扫读的短句
shots.textZone: top-right deep olive pill banner plus one two-line label centred inside each of the six discs

shots.intent: 左右同机位对照肤质状态，一眼看到洗后差异
shots.textZone: top deep olive pill banner plus one sub-heading with a hairline rule above each of the two panels

shots.intent: 用压纹封口与盖体螺纹的微距证明管装工艺，消除廉价感疑虑
把使用步骤拆成三格真实场景，降低上手门槛并给出频次预期
shots.textZone: top deep olive pill banner plus one oversized step numeral and one instruction line beside each of the three frames

shots.intent: 规格信息集中收口并给出行动按钮，把犹豫留在最后一步
shots.textZone: left deep olive block holding one headline and four label-value bullet rows, bottom edge pill button carrying one short closing line

style.backgroundSystem: seamless #FFFFFF paper pages for the packshot and the light infographic screens, herbal moss #7B8B3F tile and panel fields and deep olive #33401C blocks for claim and closing screens, every page headed by one asymmetric deep olive #33401C pill banner with a hard diagonal colour split only on the closing screen
style.iconSystem: flat two-tone badges only: herbal moss #7B8B3F ring or disc with a #FFFFFF face and one bold deep olive #33401C glyph, single line weight, no gradients, no 3D icons, no sticker shadows
style.lightingSystem: cool 5500K studio light, large soft key from the front-left with a silver fill card, crisp specular running down the product body, controlled droplet highlights on splash screens, raking side light on macro screens, soft contact shadow only and never a floating product
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent masculine herbal-apothecary ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of a seamless #FFFFFF page, deep olive #33401C, herbal moss #7B8B3F and one brushed metal accent #C6A63B; cool 5500K studio light with a large soft front-left key and a silver fill card, crisp specular on the product body and soft contact shadows only; glazed square-tile wall in herbal moss #7B8B3F with deep olive #33401C grout, matte deep olive #33401C boards and seamless #FFFFFF paper; one modern geometric sans-serif, #FFFFFF headlines inside asymmetric deep olive #33401C pill banners with hairline herbal moss #7B8B3F rules; flat two-tone ring badges with one bold glyph, no gradients and no 3D icons; the product always stands upright on its own cap at a consistent slight 3/4 or straight-on angle with the label facing the camera; stable product scale and placement; no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no colour palette changes outside #FFFFFF, #33401C, #7B8B3F and #C6A63B
no mixed fonts, no script or handwritten lettering
no gradients, 3D icons, bubble stickers or glossy bevel effects
no pastel or feminine styling, no floral ornaments
no inconsistent light direction and no missing contact shadow
style.presentationRules: the unit always stands upright on its own cap at the same slight 3/4 or straight-on angle with the label facing the camera and fully legible; identical silhouette scale on every screen; overhead angle only for skin typing and grid layout screens
style.surfaceSystem: glazed square-tile wall in herbal moss #7B8B3F with deep olive #33401C grout, matte deep olive #33401C macro board, white tiled bathroom wall #FFFFFF with a matte deep olive #33401C counter edge, one brushed metal cap accent in #C6A63B
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif only; #FFFFFF headlines set inside asymmetric deep olive #33401C pill banners, deep olive #33401C sub-headings on #FFFFFF pages with hairline herbal moss #7B8B3F rules, oversized outlined step numerals in herbal moss #7B8B3F, copy always kept to short lines
